evidence_scope_notes: Basel et al. separately report an InP film annealed at 270 °C for 4 h (main Figure 5f, blue trace). Its zinc-blende assignment belongs to that downstream film treatment; the as-made colloid's red trace remains without an assigned phase. This supporting film evidence is not an additional nanocrystal synthesis route or an identified physical batch.
